Improveasy delivers integrated commercial energy solutions that make energy upgrades simpler to manage at every stage. From early assessment and funding support, through to installation, compliance and ongoing maintenance, all whilst helping your business lower running costs, strengthen long-term performance and move towards net-zero goals. Simplicity One trusted partner for end-to-end commercial energy upgrades. Confidence Proven delivery, strong partnerships and quality you can rely on. Performance Practical energy solutions that reduce costs and improve long-term property performance. Why Commercial Energy Upgrades Matter Rising costs. Tightening regulations. Growing expectations. Commercial energy in the UK has changed fundamentally. Grid electricity now costs businesses between 20p and 35p per kWh, and there is little credible evidence that prices will fall in the medium term. At the same time, non-commodity charges, including transmission and distribution fees, are projected to account for nearly 60% of a total business energy bill by the end of 2026. For landlords and commercial property owners, the pressure is compounded by evolving Minimum Energy Efficiency Standards (MEES), with further tightening anticipated. Buildings that fall short of the EPC rating E face compliance exposure and declining asset value. Therefore, commercial energy upgrades are no longer just a sustainability consideration; they are a practical long-term business solution to real financial risk. The Benefits Are Clear Reduce energy running costs and improve operating margins Protect and improve EPC ratings across your portfolio Meet MEES compliance requirements and reduce void risk Generate on-site renewable energy and reduce grid dependency Support ESG reporting and net zero commitments Improve occupant comfort and asset appeal What We Offer Improveasy delivers a comprehensive range of commercial energy solutions from a single, trusted partner. Whether you manage a portfolio of rental properties, a social housing estate, or a local authority asset base, we offer the breadth of measures and the in-house capability to deliver them at scale.
